--- a/Eggshell/PreparationService.lean
+++ b/Eggshell/PreparationService.lean
@@ -24,6 +24,30 @@
     set next
     return admitted
 
+/-- The source ACK never depends on derived completion. After a restart,
+replay the durable registry through the existing bounded admission path.
+Discovery and source IO run in a dedicated background task, not in a search
+or the listener. A full queue retains this cursor until admission succeeds. -/
+def Pool.restoreDurable (pool : Pool) (stopping : IO.Ref Bool) : IO Unit := do
+  for (kind,folder) in [("index",← indexRegistry),("synapses",← Synapses.Journal.registry)] do
+    if ← stopping.get then return
+    let paths ← try targetReferences folder none catch _ =>
+      IO.eprintln s!"Eggshell preparation recovery could not read the {kind} registry"
+      pure #[]
+    for path in paths do
+      let key := ((path.fileName.getD "").dropEnd 5).toString
+      repeat
+        if ← stopping.get then return
+        let accepted ← try pool.notify kind key catch _ =>
+          -- Registry keys carry no original input/output or customer path.
+          pool.lastRetry.atomically do
+            set (some (Json.mkObj [("stage",toJson "durable-recovery"),("kind",toJson kind),
+              ("key",toJson key),("reason",toJson "invalid-or-unavailable-registry-target")]))
+          IO.eprintln s!"Eggshell preparation recovery skipped {kind}:{key}"
+          pure true
+        if accepted then break
+        IO.sleep 20
+
 def Pool.openWaiter (pool : Pool) (expires : Nat)
     (window : Nat := OperationWire.searchBudgetMs) : IO (Option PreparationPlan.Ticket) := do
   let now ← IO.monoMsNow
--- a/Eggshell/PublicationService.lean

@@ -1103,6 +1103,7 @@
     some <$> Research.RetentionProbe.Probe.new else pure none
   let mut activity ← IO.monoMsNow
   Client.registerHosted endpoint
+  let recovery ← IO.asTask (server.preparation.restoreDurable server.stopping) .dedicated
   try
     while !(← server.stopping.get) do
       -- Backpressure belongs before accept. Accepting and dropping a socket
@@ -1157,6 +1158,7 @@
     return 0
   finally
     server.stopping.set true
+    let _ ← IO.wait recovery
     if let some retention := retention then retention.stop
     server.preparation.close
     server.operations.close
